patterns: APPSC asks pottery identification: 1000-600 BC Gangetic plain pottery = Painted Grey Ware; Later Vedic wares list excludes NBPW.
Other PSCs ask Upanishadic king-kingdom pairs (Ashvapati - Kekaya), Kuru-Panchala as axis of Aryan culture, Bhagadugha as revenue collector.
Expect single-fact items on krishna ayas = iron and PGW sites (Hastinapur, Atranjikhera); OCP named at Hastinapur.
App MCQs are mostly sound but some stems embed duplicated A-D lists that do not match the options; app goes deeper into TN iron dates and ratnin lists.
